title: Vasya and Polynomial
statementMd:
Vasya is studying in the last class of school and soon he will take exams. He decided to study polynomials. Polynomial is a function $*P*(*x*) = *a*_{0} + *a*_{1}*x*^{1} + ... + *a*_{*n*}*x*^{*n*}$. Numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ are called coefficients of a polynomial, non-negative integer $*n*$ is called a degree of a polynomial.

Vasya has made a bet with his friends that he can solve any problem with polynomials. They suggested him the problem: "Determine how many polynomials $*P*(*x*)$ exist with **integer non-negative** coefficients so that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/022f26a75e278ec50b558954524ca5729e932807.png), and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0212320a6b840272697461ac14a2563310211a70.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95310776bcda3053fea9e3a9f129d60508d2d8c1.png) and $*b*$ are given positive integers"?

Vasya does not like losing bets, but he has no idea how to solve this task, so please help him to solve the problem.

## Input

The input contains three integer positive numbers ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ae773843333f7d3b00d2c2b7e457ab15d35f2a11.png) no greater than $10^{18}$.

## Output

If there is an infinite number of such polynomials, then print "`inf`" **without quotes**, otherwise print the reminder of an answer modulo $10^{9} + 7$.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 正在读高中最后一年，很快就要参加考试了。他决定学习多项式。多项式是函数 $*P*(*x*) = *a*_{0} + *a*_{1}*x*^{1} + ... + *a*_{*n*}*x*^{*n*}$。数值 $*a*_{*i*}$ 被称为多项式的系数，非负整数 $*n*$ 被称为多项式的次数。

Vasya 和朋友们打赌说，他能够解决所有关于多项式的问题。朋友们给他出了这样一道题：“确定有多少个多项式 $*P*(*x*)$，其系数均为**非负整数**，满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/022f26a75e278ec50b558954524ca5729e932807.png)，并且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0212320a6b840272697461ac14a2563310211a70.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95310776bcda3053fea9e3a9f129d60508d2d8c1.png) 和 $*b*$ 是给定的正整数？”

Vasya 不喜欢输掉赌注，但他完全不知道如何解决这道题，因此请帮助他解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入包含三个不超过 $10^{18}$ 的正整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ae773843333f7d3b00d2c2b7e457ab15d35f2a11.png)。

## 输出格式

如果满足条件的多项式有无穷多个，输出不带引号的 "`inf`"；否则输出答案模 $10^{9} + 7$ 的余数。
